subsystem: API19 java.util.Random and java.lang.Math gameplay primitives
observed_discontinuity: The unchanged Frozen Bubble APK consumes a second touch after GameThread reports readyToFire=1, then the worker runs BubbleManager.nextBubbleIndex without another Surface post. The execution trace records unresolved Random.<init>, Random.nextInt, Math.sin and Math.cos.
required_semantics: Random keeps a per-instance 48-bit LCG seed and returns the next 32 bits for nextInt().
Random.nextInt(bound) uses the API19 power-of-two and rejection paths, with IllegalArgumentException for nonpositive bound.
Math.sin and Math.cos evaluate the supplied double through libm.

differences.description: Random was absent from the host-side DEX core, so the original game's Random constructor and nextInt invokes did not execute API19 semantics.
differences.relevance: The first no-post interval starts when the second touch reaches BubbleManager.nextBubbleIndex.

differences.description: Math.sin and Math.cos were unresolved and currentTimeMillis returned zero.
differences.relevance: These calls are on the same original gameplay path and can change motion and timing.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: At the second original touch, the guest game thread enters BubbleManager.nextBubbleIndex while its Random call is unresolved; Surface posts stop at 24 despite continued ARM/DEX execution.

evidence.artifact: Pinned libcore android-4.4.4_r2 Random.java 48-bit LCG and native java_lang_Math.cpp sin/cos mapping; hashes in upstream map.

Simulator discovery 35971148452 at c67b5f2: unchanged Frozen Bubble APK, readyToFire=1, second touch down/up handled; posts freeze at 24 for 3 seconds, worker executes about 178.6 million instructions, and unresolved Random.<init>/nextInt and Math.sin/cos appear. This proves the public semantic gap, not yet that its repair restores gameplay.

remaining_uncertainty: The focused contract and unchanged APK must confirm that the repair passes BubbleManager.nextBubbleIndex and subsequent draw/post.
Other Random methods and exact wall-clock adjustment are not in this focused contract.
next_action: Run focused Random/Math contract, then unchanged APK two-touch regression. Classify the next observed boundary before broader Simulator discovery.
